Backend: added and passed pytest test_auth_me_kyc_fields.py (3/3) confirming kyc_verified/kyc_tier are correct for both the free and the verified premium user; the existing test_id_checker_kyc_status.py regression (4/4) still passes. Frontend: on /id-checker as the free user (French, dark), all 5 perks-teaser data-testids render inside the Enterprise Timeline preview with correctly translated French strings ('Avantages réservés aux membres vérifiés' + 3 perk rows + 'Voir les plans' CTA), the 'View plans' button navigates to /subscription/plans which renders the tiered plans page, and the sidebar user card shows the user name WITHOUT a verified chip. Mobile 390 shows the teaser without horizontal overflow (scrollWidth==clientWidth==390, teaser bbox 324px wide). Regression testids (id-checker-preview-timeline / stages / eta-card / milestones / idv-form-hero / idv-start-btn) still render.

critical_code_review_comments: Duplicate biometric-prompt modal on /auth/login intermittently blocks fresh Playwright logins if no 'Remember me' cookie exists; it is unrelated to this feature but is worth noting as it made automated verification of the verified-user flow racy. Consider adding data-testid to the 'Not now'/'Enable now' buttons or debouncing the prompt on first paint so E2E can consistently dismiss it.
id-verification.tsx remains >1000 lines (carried over from iteration_790); splitting the preview-timeline card and the new perks-teaser row into its own component would improve maintainability.
